title: Roger Goodell: Janice McNair's impact on Houston and the NFL will be felt for generations

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Roger Goodell: Janice McNair's impact on Houston and the NFL will be felt for generations
sources.description: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell is remembering Texans co-founder Janice McNair for her role in brining pro football back to Houston and her leadership during the quarter-century since the Texans joined the NFL.
